question: Why would a one-form Lord lose his status as consciousness and sovereignty?
premises: Limited luminosity is the mark of inert things.
A one-form restriction would make the Lord limited.
Consciousness and sovereignty cannot belong to what is limited like a pot.
inference: If confined to one form, the Lord would lose both consciousness and sovereignty and become like an inert object.
uncertainties: ghaṭādivat is a standard analogy for finite objects.
plain_english: He would abandon his great-lordship and his nature as consciousness, like a pot or any other finite thing. For limited luminosity is indeed the defining mark of the inert.
